attribution.note: Marcus endorses his own characterization of Brockman’s remarks.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the software-quality distinction, qualified acknowledgment, and evaluative description.

contract.note: The contract correctly declines to impose a degree of acknowledgment or a standard for rare realism that Marcus did not specify.

evidence.note: The report was published before the cutoff and documents the characterization Marcus reacted to. It cannot resolve his unspecified evaluative thresholds.

reviews.rationale: The statement combines a hedged assessment of acknowledgment with an evaluative judgment about realism. Neither supplies a testable threshold. The report clarifies context but cannot make the statement adjudicable.
